description: Firebase Cloud Firestore NoSQL architecture: collection and subcollection modeling, Security Rules for client-side access control, denormalization, transactional batch writes, and offline persistence.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Firebase Cloud Firestore NoSQL Architecture

Architect scalable, secure, and real-time document hierarchies in Cloud Firestore.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Secure every collection path with comprehensive Firestore Security Rules validating authentication and schema.
- Denormalize data deliberately to minimize shallow read operations on client apps.
- Execute multi-document mutations using atomic `runTransaction` or `WriteBatch`.
- Avoid monotonically increasing document IDs (e.g. timestamps) to prevent partition hotspotting.
